### UI Test Cases

#### TC_KYC_UI_001 — Step 1 "Add Applicants" page renders post-payment with all required elements

- **BRD/FRD Req ID:** BUYER-BRD §6 step 1; §1.10 (Max 4 applicants); INDEX.md "Step 1: Add Applicants"
- **Portal:** buyer
- **Module:** KYC
- **Type:** UI
- **Scenario:** Verify Step 1 Add Applicants page renders the post-payment celebration banner, Add Applicants section with blood-relative warning, the unit table header, primary applicant row in "Self" relationship, and the Confirm / Go to Home / + Add Applicant action buttons.
- **Preconditions:**
  - Buyer logged in (storage state `buyer.json`, mobile `8888888888`)
  - Buyer arrives at `/kyc?unitId=<base64>` via Complete KYC button OR direct URL with a valid unitId for a post-payment registration
- **Steps:**
  1. Navigate to `https://uat.xrportal.in/kyc?unitId=OTc4NA==` (or click `Complete KYC` from Home Dashboard)
  2. Wait for `networkidle`
  3. Verify presence of green confetti icon and heading text `Payment successful!`
  4. Verify subtitle text `You're just one step away from your dream home...`
  5. Verify section heading `Add Applicants`
  6. Verify warning text `Applicants can only be your blood relatives (parents, spouse, siblings, or children).`
  7. Verify table header pattern `[unit] - [tower] - [type] ([size] sq.ft.)` (e.g. `1004 - Pride - 2 Bed Growth Home (485 sq.ft.)`)
  8. Verify table columns: `Applicant | Relationship | Action`
  9. Verify primary applicant row: name | `Self` | `Verify Details` link + delete icon
  10. Verify footer note `Max. 4 Applicants allowed`
  11. Verify buttons: `+ Add Applicant` (green outline), `< Go to Home` (white outline), `Confirm >` (grey/disabled state until validation passes)
- **Expected Result:** All listed elements render exactly as documented. Page matches `kyc-add-applicants.png`. Confirm button is in grey/disabled state until applicant verification is complete.
- **Visual Evidence:** `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-add-applicants.png`
- **Test Data:** Mobile `8888888888`, OTP `258369`, unit context `1004-Pride 2 Bed (GHNG-K)`
- **Priority:** P1
- **Status:** Approved

#### TC_KYC_FUNC_002 — "+ Add Applicant" adds new applicant row (up to max 4)

- **Portal:** buyer
- **Module:** KYC
- **Type:** FUNC
- **Scenario:** Verify clicking `+ Add Applicant` adds a new row to the applicants table. Verify behaviour at boundary of 4 total applicants.

- **Steps:**
  1. Note current applicant row count = 1 (primary, Self)
  2. Click `+ Add Applicant`
  3. Verify new row appears
  4. Repeat clicks until 4 total rows are present (1 primary + 3 co-applicants)
  5. After 4 rows, attempt to click `+ Add Applicant` again
- **Expected Result:** After each click, row count increments by 1. At 4 total applicants, either the `+ Add Applicant` button is hidden/disabled or further clicks have no effect. The note `Max. 4 Applicants allowed` is visible at all times.
- **Visual Evidence:** `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-add-applicants.png`
- **Test Data:** Primary applicant pre-populated
- **Priority:** P2
- **Status:** Approved

### Workflow / End-to-End Test Cases

#### TC_KYC_WF_001 — Full E2E KYC flow: Home Dashboard → Step 1 → Step 2 drawer → Step 3 Summary → Step 4 Success → Download PDF → Go to Home

- **BRD/FRD Req ID:** BUYER-BRD §6 (full KYC flow steps 1–7)
- **Portal:** buyer
- **Module:** KYC
- **Type:** WF
- **Scenario:** Execute the complete documented KYC flow end-to-end from the Home Dashboard entry to the post-completion return.
- **Preconditions:**
  - Buyer logged in
  - At least one post-payment registration with KYC pending
- **Steps:**
  1. On Home Dashboard, click `Complete KYC` on the registration card
  2. On Step 1 Add Applicants, verify `Payment successful!` banner and unit table header
  3. Click `Verify Details` on primary applicant row
  4. In drawer, fill all personal-detail fields (per Test Data Spec) and upload all 4 documents (photo, PAN, Aadhaar front, Aadhaar back), enter PAN Number and Aadhaar Number, select Relationship = `Self`
  5. Click `Submit >` — drawer closes, applicant marked verified
  6. On Step 1, verify `Confirm >` is now green; click `Confirm >`
  7. On Step 3 Summary, verify table data; tick T&C checkbox
  8. Verify `Confirm >` turns green; click `Confirm >`
  9. On Step 4 success screen, verify `KYC submitted successfully!`, table data including `KYC Completed` status
  10. Click `Download your Unit Details` — verify PDF print dialog with `Digital Booking Form`
  11. Close PDF dialog
  12. Click `Go to Home >`
- **Expected Result:**
  - All 4 steps complete with no errors
  - PDF Download dialog renders Digital Booking Form
  - Final navigation lands on Home Dashboard
  - Submitted registration row shows updated Process Status `KYC Completed` (no longer surfaces Complete KYC alert)
- **Visual Evidence:** `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-add-applicants.png`, `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-add-applicant-form.png`, `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-summary-confirm.png`, `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-submitted-success.png`, `visual-memory/buyer/kyc/kyc-booking-form-pdf.png`
- **Test Data:** Per Test Data Spec — uses mobile `8888888888` / OTP `258369`; PAN `BAJPC4350M`; Aadhaar `216167293627`; valid JPG/PDF docs
- **Priority:** P1
- **Status:** Approved
